## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer` | `string` | no | Events matched to this customer (cus_…). |
| `customer_key` | `string` | no | Events sent with this usage key. |
| `meter` | `string` | no | Events that count toward this meter. |
| `key` | `string` | no | The event with this key. |
| `status` | `string` | no | matched, unmatched or voided. |
| `timestamp[gte]` | `string` | no | Event time on or after (unix seconds). |

| `received[gte]` | `string` | no | Received on or after (unix seconds). |
| `received[lt]` | `string` | no | Received before (unix seconds). |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Page size. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_event`. One of `usage_event`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The usage event's id. |
| `data.key` | `string` | Your idempotency key for this event, unique per business. |
| `data.customer` | `string` | The matched customer, or null while no usage key matches. |
| `data.event_name` | `string` | The usage event's event name. |
| `data.timestamp` | `string · ISO-8601` | RFC 3339 with `Z` or an offset. From 35 days in the past to 5 minutes in the future. Default: now. |
| `data.properties` | `object` | Flat, up to 50 keys and 8 KB. A meter's value property must be a number from -10^12 to 10^12 with at most 12 decimal places; a number is read from its exact text. |
| `data.amount` | `string` | The usage event's amount. |
| `data.cost` | `string` | The usage event's cost. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The usage event's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.customer_key` | `string` | The customer value the event was sent with. |
| `data.status` | `string` | The usage event's status. One of `matched`, `unmatched`, `voided`. |
| `data.meters` | `array of string` | Keys of the meters the event counts toward. |
| `data.flags` | `array of string` | `no_meter`: no active meter reads its name. `currency_mismatch`: not billed. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When we received it. |
| `data.voided_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the usage event was voided (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `data.void_reason` | `string` | The usage event's void reason. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |
| `total` | `integer` | First page only. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A page of usage events. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/usage_events?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
